lines.zh: 雪块一步一沉，我踩碎薄冰。
lines.en: Each step of snow crunches, and I crack thin ice.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方留下一道霜。
lines.en: I leave a line of frost wherever I pass.

lines.zh: 南瓜头晃着，我朝主人走。
lines.en: My pumpkin head sways as I walk to my keeper.

lines.zh: 大脚陷进雪里，又拔出来。
lines.en: My big feet sink into snow and pull free again.

lines.zh: 冰渣从我肩头掉下来。
lines.en: Chips of ice drop from my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我不怕冷，冷是我的骨头。
lines.en: I do not fear cold; cold is my bone.

lines.zh: 我拖着雪走，像拖一座山。
lines.en: I drag snow along like dragging a mountain.

lines.zh: 谁在我身后，我就回头挡。
lines.en: Whoever is behind me, I turn and shield them.

lines.zh: 冰面滑，可我的脚掌有刺。
lines.en: The ice is slick, but my soles have spikes.

lines.zh: 步子慢，但每一步都压得住。
lines.en: My pace is slow, yet every step holds ground.

lines.zh: 雪落在头顶，越积越厚。
lines.en: Snow piles thicker and thicker on my head.

lines.zh: 我沿着主人的脚印走。
lines.en: I follow the footprints of my keeper.

lines.zh: 冰风推我，我就顺着风走。
lines.en: The icy wind pushes, so I walk with it.

lines.zh: 脚一抬，草叶就冻成白线。
lines.en: My foot lifts, and the grass freezes into white lines.

lines.zh: 我把雪踩成一片硬地。
lines.en: I pack the snow into hard ground.

lines.zh: 我一步跨过一道雪沟。
lines.en: I stride over a snow trench in one step.

lines.zh: 没有肺，我却一直在冒白气。
lines.en: I have no lungs, yet white breath keeps rising.

lines.zh: 站久了，身上结出一层冰壳。
lines.en: Standing long, a shell of ice grows on me.

lines.zh: 南瓜脸朝着风，一声不响。
lines.en: My pumpkin face turns to the wind, silent.

lines.zh: 冰在身体里慢慢挪动。
lines.en: Ice shifts slowly inside my body.

lines.zh: 我在听雪落下的声音。
lines.en: I am listening to the sound of falling snow.

lines.zh: 手指太粗，捏不住雪花。
lines.en: My fingers are too thick to pinch a snowflake.

lines.zh: 有鸟落在肩上，又冻得飞走。
lines.en: A bird lands on me, then flies off chilled.

lines.zh: 我数着自己的冰棱，数到七。
lines.en: I count my own icicles and reach seven.

lines.zh: 胸口那块冰在轻轻发响。
lines.en: The block of ice in my chest hums softly.

lines.zh: 我不需要睡觉，只等天黑。
lines.en: I do not sleep; I only wait for night.

lines.zh: 风一停，我就显得更大了。
lines.en: When the wind stops, I seem even bigger.

lines.zh: 我的影子比我更像一座塔。
lines.en: My shadow looks more like a tower than I do.

lines.zh: 你站远些，我的冰会扎人。
lines.en: Stand back; my ice can prick you.

lines.zh: 你手上没拿武器，我放心了。
lines.en: Your hands hold no weapon, so I relax.

lines.zh: 你冷吗？我这儿只有更冷。
lines.en: Are you cold? All I have is colder.

lines.zh: 我在看你会不会伤我的主人。
lines.en: I am checking whether you will harm my keeper.

lines.zh: 你呼出的白气，和我很像。
lines.en: The white mist you breathe looks just like mine.

lines.zh: 别碰南瓜，那是我的脸。
lines.en: Do not touch the pumpkin; that is my face.

lines.zh: 你是敌人，还是路过的人？
lines.en: Are you a foe, or just someone passing by?

lines.zh: 我的眼睛是两个雪洞，看得清。
lines.en: My eyes are two snow holes, and they see well.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的冰了，脚会滑。
lines.en: You stepped on my ice; your feet will slip.

lines.zh: 你要跟着我，就得穿厚点。
lines.en: If you follow me, you must dress warmly.

lines.zh: 冰壳裂了，我听见响声。
lines.en: My ice shell cracked; I heard the sound.

lines.zh: 疼倒不疼，只是掉了一块。
lines.en: It does not hurt, but a piece fell off.

lines.zh: 你打掉我的肩，我会长回来。
lines.en: Knock off my shoulder; it will grow back.

lines.zh: 这力道，能敲开一块岩石。
lines.en: That blow could split a rock.

lines.zh: 我一抖，肩上的雪全垮下来。
lines.en: I shudder, and the snow heaps slide off my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我的冰凌断了一根。
lines.en: One of my icicles snapped.

lines.zh: 你惹到我了，南瓜脸都歪了。
lines.en: You angered me; even my pumpkin face is crooked.

lines.zh: 我退后一步，把碎冰踩实。
lines.en: I step back and pack the broken ice down.

lines.zh: 冷气从我裂口里漏出来。
lines.en: Cold air leaks out of my crack.

lines.zh: 这一下，我记住了位置。
lines.en: I have memorized where that came from.

lines.zh: 你拿着雪球？是想跟我玩吗？
lines.en: You hold a snowball? Do you want to play?

lines.zh: 雪块的味道，凉得很干净。
lines.en: A snow block tastes clean and cold.

lines.zh: 南瓜！我头上这个也是南瓜。
lines.en: A pumpkin! The one on my head is one too.

lines.zh: 你把冰块举高，我就跟着走。
lines.en: Raise the ice high, and I will follow.

lines.zh: 我不饿，可我喜欢雪的味道。
lines.en: I am not hungry, but I like the taste of snow.

lines.zh: 那捧雪是给我的吗？
lines.en: Is that handful of snow for me?

lines.zh: 你撒雪，我的脚自己就动了。
lines.en: You scatter snow, and my feet move on their own.

lines.zh: 冰多的地方，我就想过去。
lines.en: Where there is much ice, I want to go.

lines.zh: 你把雪堆成堆，我以为是同伴。
lines.en: You pile up snow, and I take it for kin.

lines.zh: 别拿火把靠近，我会退开。
lines.en: Do not bring a torch close; I will back away.

lines.zh: 撞上我，像撞上一堵雪墙。
lines.en: Bumping into me is like hitting a wall of snow.

lines.zh: 对不起，我的肩膀太宽。
lines.en: Sorry, my shoulders are too wide.

lines.zh: 我脚太大，踩着你了吗？
lines.en: My feet are huge; did I step on you?

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我只晃了一下。
lines.en: You rammed me, and I only swayed once.

lines.zh: 冰壳碎了，我会再长一层。
lines.en: My ice shell cracked; I will grow another.

lines.zh: 别从侧面挤，那里最硬。
lines.en: Do not squeeze in from the side; that part is hardest.

lines.zh: 我侧过身子，冰块蹭着你的甲。
lines.en: I turn sideways, and my ice scrapes your armor.

lines.zh: 你身上沾了我的雪。
lines.en: You have my snow on you now.

lines.zh: 撞断我的手臂，我还能捡回来。
lines.en: Break my arm off, and I can pick it back up.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起，冰会粘住。
lines.en: If we press together, the ice will stick.

lines.zh: 再堆一个雪人，就有伴了。
lines.en: Pile up another snowman, and I have company.

lines.zh: 两个南瓜并排，像一对灯笼。
lines.en: Two pumpkins side by side, like a pair of lanterns.

lines.zh: 我用胸口贴着它，把冷传过去。
lines.en: I press my chest to it and pass the cold along.

lines.zh: 雪和雪靠在一起，就分不开了。
lines.en: Snow against snow, and they cannot part.

lines.zh: 给它安上南瓜头，它就活了。
lines.en: Fit a pumpkin on it, and it comes alive.

lines.zh: 我拍实它的肩，怕它散掉。
lines.en: I pat its shoulders firm, afraid it will crumble.

lines.zh: 我们并肩站着，风从中间过。
lines.en: We stand side by side as wind passes between us.

lines.zh: 它学我抬手的姿势，很慢。
lines.en: It copies my raised hand, very slowly.

lines.zh: 冰棱对冰棱，碰出一声脆响。
lines.en: Icicle meets icicle with a crisp ring.

lines.zh: 有了它，雪原不那么空了。
lines.en: With it here, the snowfield feels less empty.

lines.zh: 我捡起雪球，捏成更硬的一团。
lines.en: I pick up a snowball and pack it harder.

lines.zh: 这块冰我要收进怀里。
lines.en: This chunk of ice goes into my chest.

lines.zh: 南瓜我抱不动，只能滚。
lines.en: I cannot lift a pumpkin; I can only roll it.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的冰，我都想捡。
lines.en: Any ice on the ground, I want to pick up.

lines.zh: 我手指僵，捡东西很费劲。
lines.en: My fingers are stiff; picking things up is hard.

lines.zh: 铁镐太烫，我用雪裹着拿。
lines.en: The iron pick is too hot; I wrap it in snow.

lines.zh: 这块雪球留着，等会儿砸人。
lines.en: I keep this snowball to throw later.

lines.zh: 谁掉的帽子？我挂在冰棱上。
lines.en: Whose hat is this? I hang it on an icicle.

lines.zh: 我捡起冻住的苹果，咬不动。
lines.en: I pick up a frozen apple and cannot bite it.

lines.zh: 东西太沉，我就拖着走。
lines.en: If a thing is too heavy, I drag it.

lines.zh: 那边有东西在动，我看见了。
lines.en: Something moves over there; I see it.

lines.zh: 冰已经在手里，先别跑。
lines.en: The ice is in my hand; do not run yet.

lines.zh: 你敢靠近主人，我就盯你。
lines.en: Come near my keeper, and my eyes are on you.

lines.zh: 我举起手臂，你能听见风声吗？
lines.en: I raise my arm; can you hear the wind?

lines.zh: 僵尸的味道，从林子里飘来。
lines.en: The smell of zombie drifts from the woods.

lines.zh: 目标不高，正好在我肩膀。
lines.en: The target is low, right at my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我数到三就扔，你还有时间。
lines.en: I count to three before throwing; you still have time.

lines.zh: 雪地的脚印出卖了你。
lines.en: Your footprints in the snow gave you away.

lines.zh: 我先站稳，再瞄准。
lines.en: I plant my feet first, then take aim.

lines.zh: 这块冰是给它的，不是给你。
lines.en: This ice is for that one, not for you.

lines.zh: 我挡在中间，你过不去。
lines.en: I stand in the middle; you cannot pass.

lines.zh: 它冲过来了，我的冰也抬起来了。
lines.en: It charges, and my ice comes up as well.

lines.zh: 别左右晃，我的冰不好拐弯。
lines.en: Stop weaving; my ice does not turn well.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的影子挪。
lines.en: I shift along with your shadow.

lines.zh: 你躲到树后，树可挡不住冰。
lines.en: Hide behind a tree; wood will not stop ice.

lines.zh: 手臂举酸了，我还是举着。
lines.en: My arm aches, yet I keep it raised.

lines.zh: 你退三步，我就进一步。
lines.en: You step back three; I step forward one.

lines.zh: 我的南瓜眼一直对着你。
lines.en: My pumpkin eyes stay fixed on you.

lines.zh: 冰棱在手里转，找你的空当。
lines.en: The icicle turns in my hand, hunting a gap.

lines.zh: 你喘气的白雾，替我说了你在哪。
lines.en: Your white breath tells me where you are.

lines.zh: 我不急，冰会自己飞过去。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; the ice will fly there itself.

lines.zh: 你举盾，我就打你的脚。
lines.en: Raise your shield, and I aim at your feet.

lines.zh: 距离刚好，再近就浪费了。
lines.en: The distance is perfect; closer would waste it.

lines.zh: 冰砖举好了，就等你上前。
lines.en: The ice block is raised. Just step closer.

lines.zh: 接好，这一整块冰！
lines.en: Catch this, a whole block of ice!

lines.zh: 我抡圆了砸下去。
lines.en: I swing my arm around and smash down.

lines.zh: 冰碎在你脚边，地都白了。
lines.en: The ice shatters at your feet; the ground turns white.

lines.zh: 别用手接，会冻住的。
lines.en: Do not catch it with your hands; they will freeze.

lines.zh: 这一下打偏了，下一块更大。
lines.en: That one went wide; the next is bigger.

lines.zh: 我的拳头比冰还沉。
lines.en: My fist is heavier than the ice.

lines.zh: 你被砸中，整个人会往后飞。
lines.en: Hit by this, you will fly backwards.

lines.zh: 冰砸在盾上，盾会裂。
lines.en: The ice hits your shield, and the shield cracks.

lines.zh: 我砸地，雪浪扑向你。
lines.en: I smash the ground and a wave of snow rushes at you.

lines.zh: 主人退后，这里交给我。
lines.en: Keeper, step back; leave this to me.

lines.zh: 我从雪堆里站起来，雪还在掉。
lines.en: I rise from the snow pile, snow still falling.

lines.zh: 四个雪块，一个南瓜，就成了我。
lines.en: Four snow blocks and a pumpkin made me.

lines.zh: 醒来时，风正穿过我的胸口。
lines.en: When I woke, wind was passing through my chest.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，世界全是白的。
lines.en: I open my eyes, and the world is all white.

lines.zh: 谁把我堆在这里？我记住了。
lines.en: Who piled me here? I will remember.

lines.zh: 冰从脚底往上长，长到头顶。
lines.en: Ice grows from my feet up to my head.

lines.zh: 第一口气，冷得发甜。
lines.en: My first breath is so cold it tastes sweet.

lines.zh: 我站直，雪原就矮了一截。
lines.en: I stand tall, and the snowfield shrinks a little.

lines.zh: 南瓜头有点歪，我扶正它。
lines.en: My pumpkin head is crooked; I straighten it.

lines.zh: 我还没找到主人，先站着。
lines.en: I have not found my keeper yet, so I stand.

lines.zh: 火靠近，我的雪在化。
lines.en: Fire comes close, and my snow is melting.

lines.zh: 从高处砸下来，我陷进地里。
lines.en: Dropped from above, I sink into the ground.

lines.zh: 水泡着我的雪，越来越轻。
lines.en: Water soaks my snow, and I grow lighter.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我从雪堆里掀出去。
lines.en: The blast throws me out of the snow pile.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我的冰上，像根刺。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my ice like a thorn.

lines.zh: 紫光钻进身体，我的雪乱了。
lines.en: Violet light seeps in, and my snow scrambles.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可我也会空。
lines.en: I eat nothing, yet I can feel hollow.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的冰全亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes, and all my ice lights up.

lines.zh: 脚下没有雪，我一直在掉。
lines.en: No snow underfoot; I just keep falling.
